name: The Bygones
source:
It's the year 1992. Grunge and Britpop are in full-swing, with a new band popping up every month. Unfortunately, as an employee at a record store, the genres are wearing down on Everett. One day, while busking after work, he meets a charming British man: Curtis Travers. A small CD full of gothic post-punk demos he made seals their fate and The Bygones is formed.

[From [url=https://teamsilverstrides.itch.io/the-bygones]itch.io[/url]]
